dialogues.speaker: Ho'oliu
dialogues.text: Beaches, libations, the sea breeze... Simply magical. Hey there, buddy, you're not from Natlan, yeah? Are you also here on vacation?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm just a traveler passing through.

dialogues.speaker: Ho'oliu
dialogues.text: A traveler? Nice. You must've been to many places, yeah? Are people from other nations always relaxing like this...?

dialogues.speaker: Ho'oliu
dialogues.text: You should know, we Natlanese have only just solved a crisis that's been going on for yeeears. Now, it's finally time to relax.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Other nations have their own crises.

dialogues.speaker: Ho'oliu
dialogues.text: I see... Guess life ain't easy for anyone. I'll bet you've got your own personal problems too, yeah?

dialogues.speaker: Ho'oliu
dialogues.text: Even so, it's holiday time now. Let's put all those nasty problems aside and enjoy ourselves for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Ho'oliu
dialogues.text: Here's a toast to a magnificent summer ahead!
